name: cable seated overhead curl
description: A seated curl at a high cable stack with your arms overhead. It stresses the biceps in a different way.
instructions: Set both pulleys high with a handle on each and place a bench in the middle.
Sit tall and hold a handle in each hand, palms up, arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Keep your upper arms still and curl the handles toward your head.
Straighten your arms slowly back out to the sides.
